question.problem:
Find all real eigenvalues of the matrix
$C=[\begin{aligned}6 & 0 \\ 0 & -18\end{aligned}].$
question.worked_solution:
Let's start by writing the matrix $C-\lambda I:$
﻿﻿﻿

$$
C-\lambda I=[\begin{aligned}6-\lambda  & 0 \\ 0 & -18-\lambda \end{aligned}].
$$

Now, let's find and solve the characteristic equation $det(C-\lambda I)=0:$

$$
\begin{aligned}det(C-\lambda I) & =0 \\ |\begin{aligned}6-\lambda  & 0 \\ 0 & -18-\lambda \end{aligned}| & =0 \\ (6-\lambda )(-18-\lambda )-0\cdot 0 & =0 \\ (\lambda -6)(\lambda +18) & =0\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the eigenvalues are $\lambda =-18$ and $\lambda =6.$

**Note:** The eigenvalues of a triangular (or diagonal) matrix are the entries on the main diagonal.
